ns2:course.label: Orientation to Internship
ns2:course.description: Expands students' knowledge of health professions and prepares them for internships in a variety of health settings. Topics include internship requirements, student responsibilities, preparation of resumes and cover letters, selecting an organization or internship site, interviewing, and issues of professional development. 1 undergraduate hour. 1 graduate hour. Prerequisite: Junior or senior standing.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 1 undergraduate hour. 1 graduate hour. Prerequisite: Junior or senior standing.
